cell.format: Source cell format; half-cell and full-cell configurations differ

cell.note: Other studies sharing a model name are separate sources, not a single measured parameter set.

coverage.ocp: Published BPX phase-specific fits; original measured half-cell points not located.

parameters.definition: Native BPX 1.1 model input, with source particle path and units retained; no conversion to another kinetic convention.
limitations: Published parameterisation, not an independent measurement of every input.

Electrolyte placeholder zeros are excluded. Seven additional native records transcribe the user-defined transport, thermodynamic, kinetic and contact-resistance definitions; full BPX retains all coefficients and selector flags.

external_datasets.title: Molicel P45B: published DFN OCP/parameters and multi-temperature CC, WLTP and eVTOL
external_datasets.cell_identity: Molicel INR21700-P45B 4.5 Ah, NCA/graphite-SiOx according to published BPX header. DFN paper explicitly reuses the earlier public ECM validation dataset; same model and declared reuse, not a demonstrated shared serialized specimen.
external_datasets.rate_summary: CC charge at C/30, 1C, 3C and discharge at C/30, 1C, 3C, 10C; GITT and WLTP at 10/25/40/60 degC. eVTOL is limited to 25/40/60 degC. Alternate -charge.csv files retain a charge-optimised model case, not independent experiments.

channels.note: Author format PDF defines these experimental columns, positive charge current and Peltier-controlled surface temperature. I_sim_A, V_sim_V, SOC_sim, E_OCV_V, T_sim_degC and Q_sim_W are simulated columns. E_OCV_V is predicted whole-cell OCV, not measured electrode OCP. CSV headers/numerical data remain unchecked.

license.note: Zenodo states CC BY 4.0 for the test release; its README retains copyright/all-rights-reserved and liability notices. BPX is separately in the BSD-3-Clause author repository. Do not transfer license scope between these objects; no source payload is redistributed.

review.note: All 51 ZIP member names/sizes, release metadata, README and two-page format PDF reviewed; BPX header/structure inspected. No observation CSV read. Published model parameters and measured/raw data are not merged. Follow-up: selected half-cell/parameter originals were read, pinned and extracted by scripts/seed_parameter_sources.py. Full-cell observation payloads remain unread and external.

parameter_link.evidence: Native extracted OCP/parameter records and external full-cell tests are linked by explicit study/model identity. No identical serialized specimen is asserted.
